name: rod_d_mm
note: Boom rod OUTER diameter. Kai's rod is unknown. Measure with calipers.

name: rod_wall_mm
note: Boom rod wall thickness (mass estimate only; tube assumed hollow carbon).

name: pin_d_mm
note: Release pin wire diameter (straight, hard, smooth wire). Measure it.

name: servo_l_mm
note: Servo body length (the long side, not counting mounting ears). Measure your servo.

name: servo_w_mm
note: Servo body width (short side).

name: servo_h_mm
note: Servo body height along the output shaft, base to the face the arm sits on.

name: servo_mass_g
note: Servo mass used for the mass and CG sums (the 9 g class is the worst case).

name: servo_shaft_from_end_mm
note: Output shaft centre to the near end of the body, along the length.

name: servo_arm_below_body_mm
note: Arm mid-plane to the servo body face it hangs below.

name: servo_arm_thick_mm
note: Servo arm thickness.

name: servo_arm_radius_mm
note: Distance from the shaft centre to the arm hole the pin hook goes through.

name: servo_throw_deg
note: Arm angle you will set between pin-closed and pin-open end points (servo must be able to do it).

name: frame_arm_w_mm
note: Width of the frame arm / plate the saddle blocks clamp to. Vapor5 frame is UNKNOWN here.

name: rx_l_mm
note: PWM receiver length (for the optional receiver plate).

name: rx_w_mm
note: PWM receiver width.

name: rx_mass_g
note: PWM receiver mass.

name: zip_tie_w_mm
note: Zip tie width. Slots are cut for this; measure your ties.

name: zip_tie_t_mm
note: Zip tie thickness.

name: quad_mass_g
note: Quad all-up mass with battery, for the CG-shift sums. Weigh it.

name: motor_diag_mm
note: Motor-to-motor DIAGONAL distance (true-X). Measure the Vapor5; frame geometry is UNKNOWN here.

name: prop_d_in
note: Propeller diameter.

name: boom_rear_x_mm
note: Where the rod starts, measured forward of the quad centre (negative = behind the centre).

name: boom_length_mm
note: Rod END measured forward of the quad centre. Default puts the glider hang point past the front prop edge by the margin below.

name: bore_clear_mm
note: Rod socket diameter = rod diameter + this (printed holes run small). Tune after a test print.

name: socket_wall_mm
note: Socket tube wall (6 perimeters of 0.4 mm).

name: slit_mm
note: Clamp slit width along the top of the socket.

name: socket_len_mm
note: Socket length (rod insertion depth).

name: tie_groove_depth_mm
note: Depth of the zip-tie groove round socket and rail.

name: pin_clear_mm
note: Pin hole diameter = pin wire diameter + this.

name: post_t_mm
note: Thickness of each eyelet post along the pin.

name: gap_mm
note: Gap between the two eyelet posts (the string loop sits here).

name: engage_mm
note: Pin tip depth inside the far post when closed.

name: retract_inside_mm
note: When open, pin tip is pulled back this far INTO the near post (still guided).

name: bridge_clear_mm
note: Space between the pin and the underside of the bridge over the gap.

name: bridge_t_mm
note: Bridge thickness.

name: hook_clear_mm
note: Clearance between the rear end of the pin rail and the arm hole at its most forward position.

name: servo_rod_gap_mm
note: Free space between the rod and the servo side face (room for the zip tie).

name: pad_t_mm
note: Servo pad plate thickness.

name: post_len_mm
note: Length (along the boom) of the vertical post carrying the servo pad.

name: post_w_mm
note: Width of the vertical post.

name: saddle_len_mm
note: Length of each frame saddle block along the rod.

name: saddle_rib_h_mm
note: Height of the anti-slide ribs in the saddle groove.

name: saddle_spacing_mm
note: Spacing between the two saddle blocks along the rod.

name: prop_margin_mm
note: Hang point must be at least this far forward of the front prop disc edge. Downwash column size is UNKNOWN and not modelled.

name: loop_len_mm
note: String loop length (flat, knot to end) from glider nose attachment.

name: mu_lo
note: Low combined friction coefficient (string on wire plus wire in printed hole).

name: mu_hi
note: High combined friction coefficient.

name: load_factor
note: Extra factor on the hanging weight for binding / gentle manoeuvre load.

name: usable_torque_frac
note: Fraction of stall torque treated as usable continuous pull.

name: pla_density_g_cm3
note: PLA density, 100 % solid. Weigh your prints.

name: pin_density_g_cm3
note: Pin wire density (steel).

name: rod_density_g_cm3
note: Rod material density (carbon tube).

name: misc_mass_g
note: Zip ties and tape on the whole assembly, placed at the quad centre.

name: socket_bore_d_mm
note: Rod socket bore diameter = rod_d + bore_clear.

name: socket_outer_d_mm
note: Socket outer diameter.

name: pin_hole_d_mm
note: Pin hole diameter = pin_d + pin_clear.

name: pin_axis_z_mm
note: Pin axis below the rod axis.

name: pin_axis_y_mm
note: Pin axis sideways offset from the rod axis (so the servo clears the rod).

name: rail_width_mm
note: Pin rail / eyelet post width.

name: servo_shaft_x_mm
note: Servo shaft x relative to socket rear face (socket starts at x=0, tip forward).

name: servo_shaft_y_mm
note: Servo shaft y.

name: pad_underside_z_mm
note: Underside of the servo pad plate.

name: pin_cut_length_mm
note: Straight wire to cut: closed tip to the hook, plus the hook leg.

name: pin_hook_leg_mm
note: Length of the 90-degree bent leg that goes through the arm hole.

name: pin_travel_required_mm
note: gap + engage + retract_inside.

name: arm_throw_mm
note: 2 r sin(theta/2).

name: arm_angle_required_deg
note: 2 asin(travel / 2r).

name: prop_edge_x_mm
note: Front prop disc edge forward of the quad centre (motor geometry ASSUMED).

name: hang_point_x_mm
note: Glider hang point forward of the quad centre.

name: hang_margin_mm
note: Hang point minus front prop disc edge.

name: boom_length_min_mm
note: Smallest boom_length that meets prop_margin.

name: mass_A_tip_latch_g
note: Solid PLA estimate, voxel union (+-2 %).

name: bbox_A_tip_latch_mm
note: Print bounding box as written to the STL.

name: mass_A2_servo_pad_g
note: Solid PLA estimate, voxel union (+-2 %).

name: bbox_A2_servo_pad_mm
note: Print bounding box as written to the STL.

name: mass_B_frame_saddle_g
note: Solid PLA estimate, voxel union (+-2 %).

name: bbox_B_frame_saddle_mm
note: Print bounding box as written to the STL.

name: mass_C_rx_plate_g
note: Solid PLA estimate, voxel union (+-2 %).

name: bbox_C_rx_plate_mm
note: Print bounding box as written to the STL.
